title_sq: Apartament 1+1 per shitje te Rezidenca Kadiu!
description_sq: Apartament 1+1 per shitje te Rezidenca Kadiu! Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje nder komplekseve me te fundit te ndertuar nga kompania kontakt ne Zonen e Ali Demit. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4-rt te nje pjrej godinave qe eshte ne perfundim e siper , ka nje planimetrei te rregullt, hapsira plot drite. Organizohet me hyrjen kryesore ne Korridore te vogel, ambinet i ndenjies se bashku me pjesen e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit me dalje ne ballkon edhe tualetin me ndricim natyrale. Apartamenti ka nje orientime jug lindje, ndodhet ne faze perfundimtare te punimeve edhe behet per banime ne Muajin Qershor 2026. Per me teper informacion edhe nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Rezidenca Kadiu!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Rezidenca Kadiu! The apartment is part of one of the latest complexes built by the contact company in the Ali Demi area. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of one of the buildings that is at the top end, it has a regular floor plan, spaces full of light. It is organized with the main entrance in a small corridor, the living room together with the cooking area, the bedroom with access to the balcony and the toilet with natural lighting. The apartment has a south-east orientation, is in the final phase of the works and will be ready for occupancy in June 2026. For more information and a visit to the property, contact us!
